title: untrusted-data.v1
description: Typed inert-data wrapper for accepted free text from the persistence guard to agent or tool consumers. Data cannot request tools, grant authority, or alter procedure. A consumer unable to preserve inert framing refuses the field. Consumer support is required before writer rollout; unknown majors remain opaque.

schema_version.description: Schema major version. Consumer support is required before writer rollout; unknown majors remain opaque.

record_id.description: Identity of the accepted semantic record this wrapper belongs to.

field_path.description: Dotted path to the field within the source record that holds this opaque text.

policy_version.description: Version of the content-safety-policy.v1 that admitted this value.

value.description: Accepted opaque text. Consumers must treat this as typed inert data and must not concatenate it into system instructions, commands, tool calls, paths, approvals, or authority.
